FDA posts the midazolam hydrochloride shortage

explanation.headline: FDA's records trace our supply to a plant classified OAI 596 days before the posting

sentences.text: FDA first posted the midazolam hydrochloride shortage on 2020-04-02 and it remains current as of 2026-10-21.
The label for NDC 00409230505 names Hospira, Inc. at FEI 1925262 as a registered plant.
FDA inspection 1064827 at that plant ended 2018-08-15 and was classified OAI, with the classification letter dated 2020-04-22, 596 days before the shortage posting.
A Warning Letter was issued to the same plant on 2020-03-25, 8 days before the posting.
The label also names Pfizer Healthcare India Private Limited at FEI 3008316085 as a registered plant.
FDA inspection 1106244 at that plant ended 2019-09-06 and was classified OAI, with the classification letter dated 2020-05-25, 209 days before the shortage posting.

The best option by rule is to transfer 6 vials of 1 mg/mL, 5 mL from Corvale East to Corvale General, which would raise Corvale General from 9.9 to 11 days on hand while Corvale East retains two weeks.
